column2: [intro]
I drive a used car, it’s my delight,
My ride, it’s my passion every night.
With my friends, we laugh and roam,
In our clunker, we wander through every home.
No need to be rich to feel content,
I love all things cheap, that’s my intent.
From second-hand clothes to endless sales,
In life, I see beauty in every trail.
My vacations are camping and a backpack,
Luxury is not on my track.
I feel great in bargains and deals,
Saving money is how my joy feels.
I’m cheap to the core, it drives me wild,
In my world, everything's soft as a child.
I save my coins, and it’s a blast,
If it’s not pricey, then I’m having a blast.
[ solo ]
No need to be rich to feel content,
I love all things cheap, that’s my intent.
From second-hand clothes to endless sales,
In life, I see beauty in every trail.
[outro]
